approval_basis.source: current user standing request to execute the captured work pack
approval_basis.scope: SWU-TSGR-006 exact three declared shared-path updates
approval_basis.regenerability_treatment: regeneration lowers decision cost only after exact baselines and staged identities are bound; atomic multi-target application, terminal ordering, and external consequences remain hard gates

obligations.summary: Execute exactly SWU-TSGR-006 atomic commit, terminal write, and resume.
Bind the passing SWU-TSGR-005 terminal result and joined closeout receipt.
Apply only reconciled staged outputs as one all-or-block transaction.
Record exact-present output as an idempotent no-op without duplicate effects.
Resume or block deterministically after interruption at every commit boundary.
Reject partial multi-target acceptance and contradictory idempotency replay.
Write the terminal receipt last and exclude hooks, continuation, and observation.

constraints: Execute exactly one SWU in this Task Session.
Update only the three admitted shared runner paths.
Block if any live shared target changes from its preflight digest before apply.
Do not implement SWU-TSGR-007 or later behavior.
Do not update generated mirrors, publish, promote, commit, push, or deploy.
Persist the terminal Task Session result only after live validation and allowed-write reconciliation.

done_criteria.criterion: Interruption after every boundary resumes or blocks deterministically.
Exact-present output is a recorded no-op.
Partial multi-target commit cannot be accepted.
Repeated idempotency key cannot contradict the first accepted result.
